text:
They were green like a sea,

with reflections of high sky.

-How well they knew how to look!-

those eyes I remember.


In the half-light they shone

with a mysterious light,

like two clear abysses

opened to a thousand desires.


For many hours I had near me

those green eyes,

looking at me imploringly,

and I tried not to see them!


And today, when I would like to look at them,

they are so far away... so far!

translation.title: They Were Green Like a Sea
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the remembered green eyes as sea, abyss, desire, and distance.
